correctness.rationale: A coloured clique vertex has w+q white neighbours, and either exceptional vertex w. Hence no forces while w>=2, and quotient state (w,x,y,ownership flags,mover) with 72 non-w combinations suffices. Full certificate TSV has 72 identical F3/F5 pairs; read verifier recurrence and its labelled-vertex independent cross-check. A deterministic w-independent transfer Phi for w>=2 extends F3=F5 to all w by induction, yielding root force sets {(1,1)} for even n and {(1,0),(1,1)} for odd n. Converting force counts using ceil/floor n/2 turns gives the specified seed sets, including the exceptional P3 boundary. Bounded finite certificate is a genuine base lemma, not improperly extrapolated.
